name: Shahidullah Kaiser
contribution: Shahidullah Kaiser was a Bengali novelist, journalist, editor, and political activist whose writing addressed social inequality and public life in East Pakistan.
context: Born in 1927, Kaiser worked in journalism and literature before his disappearance during the targeted abductions of intellectuals in December 1971.
impact: His novels and journalism remain part of Bangladesh's literary memory, while his disappearance links literature and journalism to the violence at the end of the Liberation War.
